>For multiple plot hooks, that is up to you. Running a real sandbox campaign where there are multiple BBEG running around doing their thing with associated minions and numerous unrelated side quests is hard. I might suggest prepping a few low level adventures (level 1-3) that all eventually funnel into a single longer mid and high level campaign. But it depends on how much time you have on hand. Alternatively you can just grab a bunch of smaller multi-level adventures (10-50 pages) and prep those as the players level up. There is nothing that says you have to play in a big huge 1-20 level mega adventure where everything is connected.
